notes: Portable object-class local-name conventions through official Federation Create and object-class lookup services. The adapter supplies provider package, standard MIM, four schema-valid FOM bindings, endpoint, logical time, and callback model. A period, unknown HLA prefix, and NA marker are rejected as local names; a hyphen-and-underscore name is accepted. Only the object-class name row is mapped, not every named FOM table. One focused packaged Umbra JNI Java parity runtime run passed (out/java-tck/object-class-name-conventions-jni-20261021.json); other Java providers, private diagnostics, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
